metaDescription: Command reference for Meridian. The /meridian reload command with permission levels and hot-reload behavior.
ogDescription: Command reference for /meridian with permissions and hot-reload details.
title: Commands
lede: All commands use the /meridian root. Permission level 2 = operator.

rows: 2
Reload the config from disk, rebuild enchantment info, and sync to all connected players

html: Reloads config/meridian.json without restarting the server. All config sections are re-read, enchantment info is rebuilt, and updated values are synced to all connected players immediately.

items: Enchanting table settings (maxEterna, treasure shelf requirement, global minimum enchantability)
Shelf behavior (sculk shrieker chance, particle rates)
Anvil settings (prismatic web cost, iron block repair toggle)
Tome XP costs and durability values
Per-enchantment overrides (max levels, power functions, enable/disable)

items.title: Note on Shelf Stats
html: Shelf stat contributions (Eterna, Quanta, Arcana, etc.) are loaded from datapacks, not the config file. To change what stats a shelf block provides, create or modify JSON files in data/meridian/enchanting_stats/ within a datapack and use /reload (the vanilla datapack reload command).

items.title: Level 2 — Operator
html: The reload command requires op level 2. This is the only command Meridian registers — all other interaction happens through the enchanting table, anvil, and library GUIs.

items.title: Permissions Mods
html: Meridian gates reload on the vanilla op level (2) rather than a custom permission node, so a permissions mod such as LuckPerms grants access by setting the player's op level — for example /lp user <name> permission set minecraft.command.op or granting op directly.
